
workstation is set up in 2m05s.

Claude Code and Codex are installed and run as the agent, an account without sudo that can install Ubuntu packages (keelbox install). The box is this machine. It is on your tailnet. SSH from the internet closes once keelbox apply workstation reaches it over the tailnet from another computer; keelbox doctor workstation says whether it has.

Start working:
  This computer   keelbox attach workstation
                  opens the agent's terminal on this machine. Close it and the work carries on; run it again to come back.

  Phone over SSH  add your phone's key to the box first:
                  https://keelbox.dev/docs/guides/sessions

  Check the box   keelbox doctor workstation        all boxes: keelbox ls
